reason: The user confirmed scope, language, demo-projector readability and the locked direction for the ChirieSigură phone pages. The team plan's tests pin exact strings. The impeccable detector flagged a rounded-cell border, and review captures needed ignoring. A project skill keeps the next phone-page session from repeating these decisions.
The trigger only covered editing, but this episode's work was mostly 390 px layout measurement, screenshot capture and committing. Those tasks should also load this skill's rules.
During the restyle the reportLine text was kept only because the Task 11 test requires it. The rule needs to be explicit so a future visual change does not drop or reword a pinned string.
The episode found and fixed layout overflow at 390 px through repeated measurement. Those thresholds and the bar position are the concrete constraints a future edit can break without noticing.

The branch was behind origin by a teammate's commit, and the user asked to check for pushed commits after an auto-continuation. The earlier commit also swept in session notes and spent mock-ups, so a stat check before push is a needed step.
Reaching each named state (done, viewing done, consent with code) required priming sessionStorage this way. The approach is project-specific and the keys are easy to get wrong.

Local dev and deploy steps were not in this skill. Without apps/web/.env.local and PHONE_PEPPER, the number-check route returns 500. Pushes do not deploy, so a deploy needs the explicit Vercel command.

The SIM-swap failure string and the consent line are now driven by a configurable window. The pinned string stays valid only for the default, and a future session editing the phone pages needs to know the copy must follow the same setting.
The locked direction changed from The Confirmation Screen to Tram Line this session. The old line would send the next session to a discarded design, so it is superseded here.
The consent label changed with the Tram Line build; the old "Kept / Never kept" wording is stale.
The state words were treated as pinned during the Tram Line restyle, but the pinned list omitted them, so a future restyle could reword them unnoticed.

Tram Line finish review found the "Phone near the apartment" stop vanishing on a SIM-swap failure, which breaks the user's step-record guardrail. The rule for unreached stops belongs with the guardrail.

The finish reviewer found a misleading retry after a SIM-swap failure, and the alert read as a double negative. The fix, which names the real recovery from the window helper, is durable product copy logic for the phone pages.

The old advice (add an inset ::after underline to code cells) directly contradicts the finish review's fix, which deleted that underline because the plate read as an input field. Reconciling it here prevents the stale rule from reintroducing the fake-input look.
User replaced the ✅ emoji with a drawn check in the report option; the pinned-string list still says ✅, so it is now stale and would mislead the next session.
The DESIGN.md rewrite landed this episode, so the "still documents the discarded look" guidance is now false and would keep the next session treating the doc as stale.
A wrap bug in the report line was fixed by a technique that the next layout fix would otherwise undo (wrapping in spans), and a test-matching constraint decides which technique is allowed.

The episode planned the /viewing signed-out gate by reading CheckForm.tsx and check.test.tsx. The working pattern there (server page passes signedIn, sign-in link with returnTo, test on the client component) is not recorded in this skill, and the plan first hedged it as an open question.
The /check soft note is a new pinned string with a ruled alert style. The phone-pages skill owns the pinned-strings list and the warn alert pattern, so the copy and styling belong there too.

A phone-page implementer shipped with its 390 px check skipped and was marked done with a concern. The layout budget here is the one thing this skill exists to protect, so the measurement belongs in the brief itself, not left as an optional observation.
